prompt: Each train car is hooked to the next one, so adding a car in the middle means unhooking just two links.
why: Cheap insertion by relinking: a linked list.
trap: An array would shift every later car.

prompt: In a scavenger hunt, each clue tells you where the next clue is.
tells: each clue tells you where the next clue is
why: One link to the next: a linked list.
trap: A graph has many links; here there's one 'next'.

prompt: To reach the 50th item you must start at the first and follow 49 links.
why: No jumping by position: a linked list.
trap: An array would jump straight there.

prompt: A playlist lets you insert a song after the current one without shifting the rest.
trap: Shifting is what an array would do.

prompt: Each node holds a value and a pointer to the next node, and the last one points to nothing.
why: One next pointer each: a singly linked list.
trap: A tree node points to children, not one next node.

prompt: Removing an item from the middle only changes the neighbour's next pointer.
tells: only changes the neighbour's next pointer
trap: In an array everything after it would move.
